statusDefinitions.missing: The production capability is not implemented in Godot.
statusDefinitions.partial: A working foundation exists, but production behavior or coverage is incomplete.
statusDefinitions.parity: The production capability is implemented and protected by release-level evidence.

features.label: Action combat and expedition loop
features.nextGate: Port all production loadouts, enemy behavior, bosses, run modifiers and mobile combat feedback.

features.label: Command ranks, contracts and research
features.nextGate: Implement Command progression, contract lifecycle and research with deterministic persistence tests.

features.label: Star map, sectors, stations and travel
features.nextGate: Port sector discovery, route locking, travel costs, stations and map state.

features.label: Markets, cargo, credits and trade
features.nextGate: Port inventory, cargo limits, fuel cells, market pricing and transaction result contracts.

features.label: Ship modules, refuel, repair and logistics services
features.nextGate: Port modular ship state and safe service transactions with insufficient-resource tests.

features.label: World events, faction reputation and consequences
features.nextGate: Port production event chains, reputation thresholds and persistent consequences.

features.label: SAG HQ, recruitment campaign and finale
features.nextGate: Port campaign steps, faction choices, rewards, finale and replay-safe state transitions.

features.label: Kiwimi dialogue depth, trust and archive
features.nextGate: Port dialogue branches, trust conditions, one-time rewards and the Kiwimi archive.

features.label: Versioned saves and existing-player migration
features.nextGate: Add an explicit browser-localStorage export/import bridge and verify migration from every production namespace.

features.label: Touch controls and narrow-screen flows
features.nextGate: Add real touch-event regression, orientation changes and low-end mobile performance budgets for the Godot export.

features.label: Accessibility settings and readable interaction states
features.nextGate: Port reduced motion, contrast, text scaling, focus handling and keyboard-only menu coverage.

features.label: GitHub Pages deployment from the release source
features.nextGate: Deploy a validated Godot artifact through the same protected Pages pipeline and run a post-deploy smoke test.

features.label: Reproducible WordPress plugin packaging
features.nextGate: Validate the generated Godot plugin ZIP, required WASM/PCK assets and readiness handshake in CI.
